v1.health_status: The ability to move quickly and reaction time are below expectations for the age. In health terms, this indicates a neuromuscular system with slow responses to external stimuli and low cardiovascular efficiency in explosive efforts, causing early fatigue and shortness of breath in short runs.
v1.to_improve: The student needs to develop stride efficiency and pace gain. The initial focus should be on running drills (such as lifting the knees and heels), coordinating breathing and arm movement to unlock foot agility and improve basic aerobic conditioning.

v4.health_status: Exceptional physical performance. The student has a very short reaction time and impressive acceleration, reaching maximum speed with ease. The cardiorespiratory system and skeletal muscles show very high metabolic efficiency and perfect neuromuscular coordination.
v4.to_improve: The goal now is to preserve this high performance and prevent injuries. Because this generates a great deal of force and speed, the student should focus on thorough warm-ups before training and on flexibility exercises to keep muscles long, elastic, and protected against strains.
v4.recommendation: Congratulations on the excellent physical vigor. We will continue to offer high-intensity challenges in class to keep the student motivated and healthy.

f3.recommendation: Congratulations on the excellent physical support. We will continue with challenging stimuli in class to maintain the student's muscular health.

Basic Data: Profile stimulated by solving logical problems, ease with numerical data, and a deep interest in deciphering how new technologies work.

Associated Careers: Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Architecture, and Information Technology.
m7_7.reflection: We diagnose in the student a predominantly abstract, analytical, and deductive cognitive structure. Their mind operates systemically and finds motivation in discovering patterns, equations, and data architecture.
